peach-cream.$description: Peach Cream — Page canvas, hero backgrounds, dominant surface — the warm skin of the entire site

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, pill CTA fill, nav icons, borders — near-black rather than pure #000 for slightly softer edges

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces on cream sections, button labels, inverted text on black CTAs

cool-mist.$description: Cool Mist — Secondary surface, link/button hover washes, soft card backgrounds when a section needs visual cooling

slate.$description: Slate — Muted body text, secondary headings, icon strokes — lifts information below the black primary

hairline.$description: Hairline — Borders, dividers, list-item separators on neutral surfaces

deep-violet.$description: Deep Violet — Brand primary — display headlines, decorative strokes, key UI accents; saturated enough to dominate 158px type against the cream canvas

midnight-plum.$description: Midnight Plum — Headline emphasis, link text, dark card backgrounds — the second register of the violet system, used when Deep Violet needs a partner with more weight

lime-wash.$description: Lime Wash — Accent card surface, decorative wash — fresh, spring-green that lights up product/feature blocks

acid-lime.$description: Acid Lime — Saturated green highlight inside illustrations and graphic accents — punctuation color, never structural

lilac-haze.$description: Lilac Haze — Soft pink-purple card wash, pastel type accent — gentle partner to Deep Violet

orchid-pop.$description: Orchid Pop — Saturated pink-purple for decorative shapes and graphic punctuation sitting over lilac or cream

sky-wash.$description: Sky Wash — Cool blue card surface — the cool counterweight to the warm canvas in feature blocks

periwinkle.$description: Periwinkle — Saturated blue highlight for icons and illustration fills

apricot.$description: Apricot — Warm accent card surface — echoes the cream canvas but steps up in saturation for energy

burnt-sienna.$description: Burnt Sienna — Dark warm accent for display text and decorative borders — the orange system's deep register

mmpolyvariable.$description: Display headlines only — ultra-condensed geometric face that carries page-level authority at 75–158px. The narrow proportions let

mmsansvariable.$description: Secondary sans for sub-headlines and short labels that sit beneath the poly display — keeps the brand on one type system without competing with the hero. Substitute: Inter, Söhne, or General Sans.

mmeuclidcircularb.$description: Body, UI, nav, buttons, badges, inputs — the workhorse. Circular geometric forms keep a friendly counterpoint to the aggressive poly display. Weight 500 for nav, 700 for button labels, 400 for body. Tight line-height 0.80 used for badge micro-text. Substitute: DM Sans, Nunito, or Nunito Sans.
